deployments_detail.use: Uses Google Cloud data and AI platform across operations, products and services; strategic AI collaboration with Tencent Cloud for a banking AI platform

Generative AI to provide customers with more personalised guidance and tailored services/features, using foundation models via Vertex AI integrated with BigQuery analytics. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery); DKatalis]

Machine learning and AI-driven analytics embedded in the Jago App's features (money management, auto-budgeting 'Pockets', personalized in-app experience) built by engineering arm DKatalis. [DKatalis (data science/ML); MongoDB Atlas as data backbone]

ML-based credit scoring / underwriting that analyzes borrower behavior patterns and digital-ecosystem data to predict likelihood of default, drawing on data from Jago's ecosystem partners (e.g. GoTo/Gojek). [none]

Contact centre performance coach that automatically reviews customer call recordings and provides personalized feedback and targeted recommendations to improve agent performance and quality assurance. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI Model Garden foundation models); DKatalis]
deployments_detail.value: Enables evaluation of a larger share of customer calls vs. only ~5% of calls without AI

deployments_detail.use: Risk management assistant that analyses transaction patterns to detect activity indicative of fraud and issues real-time alerts to bank staff in natural language for immediate action. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Vertex AI Model Garden foundation models incl. Gemini, BigQuery); tech partner DKatalis]

Market intelligence assistants that distill text- and audio-based customer engagements into reports with actionable insights on customer pain points, sentiment and preferences. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Vertex AI Model Garden, BigQuery); DKatalis]
deployments_detail.value: Reports produced in minutes vs. a task that used to take months to complete manually

deployments_detail.use: Internal AI 'co-pilot' for employees: staff use available AI solutions/tools to optimize daily work and decision-making, supported by the bank's data science and machine learning capability-building culture. [none]

MLOps pipeline for deploying trusted AI models: Vertex AI Pipelines to standardize/validate AI solutions before deployment and Vertex AI Model Registry for centralized model management. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI Pipelines, Vertex AI Model Registry); DKatalis]
